question: how long is the password reset link valid?
expected_answer: The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: We have 40 users. Which plan do we need and what refund terms apply?
expected_answer: ENTERPRISE (PRO allows up to 25 users); ENTERPRISE refunds follow the signed order form.

question: How much does the on-premise edition of Acme Cloud cost?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base - the assistant should say it does not know.

question: typed my password wrong a few times and now i'm locked out, how long do i wait??
expected_answer: The account is locked for 15 minutes after five failed attempts.

question: Is our company data stored in India?
expected_answer: Yes - data for Indian accounts is stored only in India: Mumbai, with encrypted backups in Hyderabad.

question: We're on PRO and our integration keeps getting ERR-4290. What is our limit and what can we do?
expected_answer: ERR-4290 means the rate limit was exceeded; PRO allows 600 requests per minute. Reduce the request rate, retry after Retry-After, or upgrade (ENTERPRISE: 3,000).

question: What is the maximum size of a file I can attach to an invoice?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base - the assistant should say it does not know.

question: Which languages can the dashboard be shown in?
expected_answer: English, Hindi, Tamil, Marathi and Bengali.

question: What does the PRO plan cost per user per month?
expected_answer: INR 999 per user per month (exclusive of 18% GST), or INR 9,990 per user per year.

question: How long do PRO customers have to ask for a refund?
expected_answer: Within 30 days of the first payment (monthly) or of the annual payment (annual).

question: i got charged twice for the same invoice. what now?
expected_answer: Wait 5-7 working days for the bank to release the authorisation; if both charges remain, email billing with both transaction references. Duplicates are always refunded.

question: Can I export my contacts to Excel?
expected_answer: Yes - Contacts, select them, Export > Excel. Exports of more than 10,000 contacts are emailed.

question: The dashboard shows Error 503. What should I do?
expected_answer: Check status.acmecloud.example; if all is green, clear the cache and reload; contact support if it lasts more than 10 minutes.

question: For how many days is an invitation to join our team valid?
expected_answer: Seven days.

question: What happens to the records a user created when I remove that user?
expected_answer: They are kept and reassigned to the account owner.

question: How long do you keep database backups?
expected_answer: Backups are taken every hour and kept for 35 days.

question: When will API v1 be switched off?
expected_answer: On 31 March 2027.

question: Do NGOs get a discount?
expected_answer: Registered non-profits and educational institutions in India get 30% off PRO.

question: Which version added dark mode to the mobile app?
expected_answer: Version 3.3 (July 2026).

question: We want scheduled reports delivered to Slack. Which plan do we need and since which version is Slack supported?
expected_answer: Scheduled reports need PRO or ENTERPRISE; delivery to Slack was added in version 3.4.

question: Our company needs single sign-on with Okta and our own encryption keys. Which plan fits?
expected_answer: ENTERPRISE - it supports any SAML provider and bring-your-own-key (BYOK); PRO has only Google and Microsoft SSO and no BYOK.

question: If we close our account, how long until our data is gone from your backups as well?
expected_answer: Data is kept 30 days after closing, then deleted from live systems; it disappears from backups after the 35-day backup retention - so up to about 65 days.
